title: Grateful Dead Live at Cleveland Public Hall on 1973-12-06

ai_review.summary: The China > Rider transition is legendary, but the soundboard recording suffers from noticeable splice edits.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the extraordinary jam that bridges "China" into "The Rider," calling it one of the best transitional moments ever captured. However, the recording contains splices that break up otherwise seamless jams (including Dark Star), which detracts from the listening experience despite the strong performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks for the musical content, especially the China>Rider jam, but the second reviewer highlighted splice issues that affect the recording's continuity, leading to a solid yet imperfect overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splice edits are present between jams (China>Rider, Dark Star, etc.), interrupting the flow; no comments on clarity or mix balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set features an exceptional transitional jam that stands out, though the recorded splices make the flow feel less seamless than it was live.
